experiment: Offline reranker scope A/B on the dev set (ipindia_2026-09, 130 docs)
candidates: each document's devA ranked list (wipo2026_dev__abstract/results.jsonl), top 100; only the reranker scope text varies
reranker: BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, max_length 1024, pair = (scope text, title + newline + abstract)

variants.compact_own_notes: path_only plus the candidate's own WIPO notes only, capped at 600 chars

policy_replay: benchmark.simulate_policy (hierarchy fix) over each variant's new top 20; evidence scores reused from devA; a candidate without a recorded evidence score is assumed to pass (count in top1_on_assumed_evidence); rules not replayed
levels: [subclass, main group, exact]; truth = all recorded IPC symbols parsed from ground_truth (not filtered to catalogue presence)

files.rows.jsonl: per document: n_candidates and, per variant, the new top-20 order and every candidate's reranker score
files.rerank_scope_ab.py: the script that produced them (run from apps/api with IPC_DB_TARGET=sakthi)
